title: THE MOUNTAIN
topic: The Mountain: Why did God ask Abraham to sacrifice his son? (Genesis 22)

beats.camera: Low dolly up the dawn mountain path behind Abraham and Isaac; rocks pass close to the lens.
sfx: soft whoosh as hook title flies to caption
beats.notes: Huge hook title WHY WOULD GOD ASK THIS? fills the centre 0-1.8 s, then shrinks and flies into the caption spot.

beats.text: The first time the Bible says *love*… a father is told to give up his *son*.
beats.camera: Slow push-in and gentle orbit as the sky warms from cool blue to gold.

beats.text: "Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou *lovest*…"
beats.camera: Ghosted night shot of Abraham's tent under a soft beam of light, very slow zoom.

card.quote: Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou LOVEST…

beats.text: It sounds nothing like *love*. But most people miss *three* details.
beats.camera: Dim, blurred mountain far away behind a plain search bar.

diagram.searchBar: why did god ask abraham to sacrifice isaac
suggestions: why did god ask abraham to sacrifice isaac
did abraham know god would provide
diagram.detailCounter: appears on 'three': three empty gold dots, 3 DETAILS

beats.text: On the *third day*, Abraham saw the mountain, far off.
beats.camera: Wide high-angle desert pan with a fast sun-and-moon time-lapse.

beats.text: But notice what he told his servants: "I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and *come again* to you."
beats.camera: Foot of the mountain: servants and donkey stay, Abraham and Isaac walk on; slow crane up.

card.quote: …I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and COME AGAIN to you.

beats.text: *We* will come back. Abraham believed God could raise Isaac… even from the *dead*.
beats.camera: Push-in on the two figures walking away together.

beats.text: Detail two: Isaac carried the *wood* up the hill, and asked, "Where is the *lamb* for a burnt offering?"
beats.camera: Climbing shot, side-on and high; Isaac stops and turns his head up to his father.
sfx: fire crackle from the fire pot
beats.notes: Frame this shot carefully: S9 match-cuts to the exact same camera.

beats.camera: Same climb, camera holds as they walk on together.

card.quote: …My son, God will provide himself a LAMB…

beats.text: At the top, God *stopped* Abraham's hand.
beats.camera: Mountain top, stone altar with wood; Isaac sits calm; Abraham lifts an empty hand; beam of light bursts down; everything slows.

labels.text: LAY NOT THINE HAND UPON THE LAD · GENESIS 22:12

beats.text: Detail three: a ram, caught in a thicket… died *in his place*.
beats.camera: Camera turns behind them to reveal a ram in a thorny thicket with a glowing gold ring.

title.at: after the sentence, held through the pause

sfx: gentle chime on IN HIS PLACE

beats.text: About two thousand years later, another *Son* carried *wood* on His back… to Golgotha.
beats.camera: MATCH CUT: identical camera and framing to S6; Jesus walks with the wooden cross beam on His back, seen from a distance.

beats.text: This time, there was no ram. And God did *not* stop it.
beats.camera: Slow pull-back to a cross on a hill under a dark sky. No ram, no light.

beats.text: "He that *spared not* his own Son, but delivered him up for us all…"
beats.camera: Full-screen verse card over the ghosted dark hill.

card.quote: He that SPARED NOT his own Son, but delivered him up for us all…

beats.text: That mountain was a *picture* of what God would do… for *you*.
beats.camera: Light breaks through the clouds onto the cross; warm glory gold; people walk in and gather in the light; slow crane up.
Hold on the crowd in the light around the cross.

labels.text: BEHOLD THE LAMB OF GOD · JOHN 1:29

beats.text: Abraham's *faith*, or God's *love*: which one hits you harder? Tell us in the comments.
beats.camera: Dark warm background; two big icons.

choices.label: FAITH

choices.label: LOVE
